name: foldseek-server
description: Structure search against an MMseqs2-App backend: submit, inspect, export results as files, forward hits.

tools.name: get_result_summary
tools.description: Bounded summary of a finished result

tools.name: export_result
tools.description: Write the complete result to files

tools.name: select_hits
tools.description: Name a set of hits for forwarding

tools.name: select_msa_columns
tools.description: Name alignment columns and derive their motif

tools.name: send_to
tools.description: Forward a hit or selection into a new job

base_url.title: Server URL
base_url.description: Origin of the Foldseek Server deployment. Defaults to the public instance; change it to point at your own.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where cached results, selections and exported artifacts are kept. Leave empty for ~/.foldseek-server. Artifact handles are only durable if this stays put.

shared_dir.title: Shared folder
shared_dir.description: One folder shared with Claude, in both directions: exports/ for result files, imports/ for structures you want searched. Pick a folder Claude can be granted. Leave empty to keep exports inside the state directory.

input_dir.title: Readable input directory
input_dir.description: A further folder the server may read structure files from, never swept. Must not sit inside the shared folder. Optional.
